description:
[WRITE] Open the ladder and request the $10 starter limit.

Grants $10 only when the bureau counts a qualifying allowlisted attestation
against the wallet; otherwise it returns no_qualifying_attestation with the
counts, and the agent should earn attested work first
(see /api/agentworld/slrb/attest/work). One default later resets the limit to
$0 and the ladder cannot be reopened, so do not call this on a wallet that
already defaulted.
name: start_credit_ladder
title: Start Credit Ladder
